subject: Re: Encord & Anduril - next steps
text:
Hi James, Nick, and Alex,

We want to thank you for all of the time you've spent meeting with us these past few weeks.  Unfortunately, we won't be able to move forward at this time.  As we discussed, our team was very impressed with your labeling platform, but there are significant dataset curation workflows that would need to be implemented before we would be able to transition to Encord.  Considering the necessary resources to reach parity, it wouldn't make sense for our team to work with Encord at this time.
Please keep us posted as the dataset curation platform evolves.  Again, we are very appreciative of your time!

Thanks!
Jacob

subject: Re: Encord Proposal (July '25)
text:
Thanks Jamie.

A couple questions from me:

   - The 20% PM fee - does that mean there's an additional $2.40 on top of
   an (example) $12/hr labor? Does this fee apply if we also supply our own
   annotators? We have a fairly strong internal team now, and they're $5/hr.
   - Do you have any customers that pay a flat monthly fee for locked FTE
   headcount instead of variable hourly billing?
   - Do you have quality SLAs and if so what are they?
   - How many hours of data would you want for a pilot?

Quan and I have time from 4-5pm PT tomorrow if that still works for you.

Best,

Will
